title: Asia Times — 'Trump-Xi summit didn't change North Korea's strategic reality': Dr. Patrick Cronin 분석
snippet: Dr. Patrick M. Cronin analysis: 'ceremony is not strategy. Summit atmospherics have a short shelf life when unaccompanied by concrete agreements.' China prioritizes NK as geopolitical buffer, not denuclearization partner. Kim Jong Un in 2026 has enhanced nuclear confidence, Russian military backing, constitutional legitimacy absent in 2018. Three factors preventing US-China cooperation: (1) Taiwan as primary concern, (2) weaponized interdependence in semiconductors/AI/rare earths, (3) managed rivalry framework emphasizing deterrence without resolution. Recommends strengthening US-ROK-Japan trilateral.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 동일 URL 또는 유사 분석 없음. 트럼프-시진핑 정상회담의 북핵 정책 함의를 심층 분석한 신규 기사.
